div.div: جَنِينَةٌ , accord. to the copies of the K, but in the M ↓ جِنِّيَّةٌ , (TA,) A [garment of the kind called] مِطْرَف, (K, TA,) of a round form, (TA,) like the طَيْلَسَان, (K, TA,) worn by women: (TA:) in the T, said to be certain well-known garments. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
